descriptionChirho: The period of fading light after sunset; dusk or nightfall, often associated with darkness, secrecy, or the onset of night (Job 24:15, Prov 7:9, Isa 5:11, 59:10).
The period of emerging light before sunrise; dawn or daybreak, marking the transition from night to day (1 Sam 30:17, Ps 119:147).
